title: chlorophora excelsa
intro: Chlorophora excelsa, commonly known as iroko, is a tropical tree species native to Africa and parts of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing fever and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Chlorophora excelsa include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-microbial agent, making it effective in treating various conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Chlorophora excelsa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
